title: Secret Lair Countdown: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Worshippers are allowed to pluck one memory from a chosen nonbeliever. Maybe a battle plan. Maybe a profession of love.
Everyone gets some time in the good soil. This week it's the Turnipsons.
They say you can't take it with you, but he's out to prove them wrong.
"Again—mana! And tap it! And cast! Feel the burn—you're doing great!"
Always they are watching, carefully tallying twig snaps.
Many live lives of quiet desperation. His is quite loud.
Bala Ged scribes have stanza upon stanza of its exploits stalking jungles and the mirey quags within.
His cleverness is well regarded among the akki, but most of his jokes are just variations on "Leaving Zo-Zu'n?" and then he shoots fire at you.

While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

"We see the same sky as you, just through a different lens."
